test_generate_example: test the _generate_examples method to parse valid CoNLL input and yield structured examples with tokens, pos, chunks, and ner fields
test_generate_corrupted_example: test the _generate_examples method raises ValueError when input lines have mismatched feature column counts
build_conll_dataset_builder: build a subclass of ConllDatasetBuilder with ConllBuilderConfig to create a TensorFlow dataset from CoNLL-formatted text files
create_conll_builder_config: create a ConllBuilderConfig with separator and ordered_features to define the schema for CoNLL dataset parsing
test_conll_config_features: test that generated examples contain all features defined in CONLL_2003_ORDERED_FEATURES in the correct order
